wholeDecisionChangesBefore.rationale: BB-Source-Ziel ist durch vorhandene kanonische Wirtschaft-Ziele fachlich abgedeckt; partial/1:n beschreibt nur die Zuordnungsform, nicht eine fachliche Lücke.

Actual BB original PDF/printed20–21: LK Personal is a wahlobligatorische selected alternative. The S21 performance checks democratic workplace participation and explains basic BetrVG AND MitbestG provisions. 776 partial supplies works-council/workplace participation; fab partial supplies ordinary supervisory-board corporate participation under supplied MitbestG rules and its distinction from the works council. The whole fab contract additionally compares Montan co-determination; that additional performance is a consciously retained whole-goal didactic extension, never a BB original-source mandate. The existing full81d practice already offered in BBLK assesses fab plus912;912 is a consciously continued whole practice performance and has NO Source21 edge. No compulsory GK target or universally compulsory LK Personal/Montan/Arbeitsdirektor follows. Existing776 edge and all unrelated mappings/decisions are exact. This new bounded Source/Course union awaits independent C qualification; no author scientific self-approval.

wholeDecisionChangesAfter.rationale: Actual selected LK Personal S20/21 requires tasks/procedure of personnel planning and employer/employee analysis. The one new planning goal and supplied material exercise the whole quantity/skill/timing planning process and both perspectives. Old career-profile/employment-contract goals retain their separate genuine contracts and other source edges; they are not full planning proxies. Independent qualification pending.

Actual selected LK Personal S20/21: democratic workplace participation plus basic BetrVG AND MitbestG. Retained776partial covers workplace participation; fabpartial covers ordinary corporate supervisory-board participation and distinction from works council. Wholefab additionally compares Montan boards as expressly authored didactic extra; BB original does not mandate Montan or Arbeitsdirektor. Unsupported81d BB placement is removed;912 has no BB target or Source21 edge. Source21 union776+fab was independently qualified by C. The new local endpoint, if technically required, assesses only3 real Personal atoms+776+fab, never912.

Actual S21 has two independently assessable performances: discuss leadership principles; assess personnel-development strategies. New leadership and development atoms separately carry those facets. The two partial edges form the actual whole-source performance union; neither alone claims the whole combined source aspect. Supplied qualification/employee-appraisal evidence faithfully operationalises the S20 content label. This is selected LK Personal, not a mandatory GK or universal LK requirement. Independent qualification pending.
